page.layout: One blank leaf. A handwritten manuscript note in ink runs across the upper part of the page. No printed text.
page.notes: The only text is a handwritten note in ink across the top of the leaf, in a cursive hand. It is not printed, so it is not transcribed. It reads approximately: "Medulla Theologiae christianae fundamentum erat huius operis egregii. Medulla [...] Francuii 1696. 4to ex qua hoc ve formabatur Corpus, vid. Stollens Historie theologischen Gelahrtheit pag. 22 et 23. et Bibliother. Fabric. Histor. P. III pag. 379 sqq." Some words are not legible enough to copy with certainty. No printed running head, page number or catchword is present.
